topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Biology
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture series, outlines the course objectives and learning outcomes, and frames cancer as a complex clinical and biological problem.

topics.label: Cancer as a Failure of Differentiation and Tissue Organization
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how accumulated genetic and epigenetic alterations disrupt normal cellular differentiation and tissue architecture, and how these processes are modeled experimentally.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Tumor Invasion and Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how tumors transition from benign localized growths to malignant diseases through local basement membrane invasion and metastatic dissemination to distant organs.

topics.label: Stepwise Tumor Progression, Behavior, and Nomenclature
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics illustrate how benign precursor lesions evolve into invasive carcinomas using colorectal cancer as a model, examine the clinical risks of benign growths, and outline the classification and nomenclature of tumors.

topics.label: Pathophysiological Mechanisms of Cancer Illness and Death
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the specific pathophysiological mechanisms by which primary and metastatic tumors cause systemic disease, organ failure, and patient mortality.

topics.label: Cancer Incidence Across Humans and Diverse Animal Species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine epidemiological patterns and incidence rates of different cancer types in human populations and across diverse multicellular animal species.

topics.label: Clinical Detection and Cancer Screening Strategies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the principles of early clinical detection and evaluate the methods, efficacy, and limitations of screening programs across different cancer types.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Next Steps
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture by reviewing the learning outcomes and providing housekeeping notes for upcoming practicals and sessions.
